# Calculate the n-th Fibonacci number using a while loop count = 2 # We've already calculated the first two numbers while count < n: # Calculate the next Fibonacci number fib_next = fib_prev + fib_curr
# Update fib_prev and fib_curr for the next iteration fib_prev = fib_curr fib_curr = fib_next
# Increment the count count += 1
return fib_curr
